FC Haka, originally Valkeakosken Haka, commonly known as Haka, is a Finnish professional football club based in the industrial town of Valkeakoski. The club was founded in 1934 and competes in Finland's second division the Ykkösliiga. It is one of the most successful clubs in Finland, with nine Finnish championships and 12 Finnish Cup wins.
